title: Libre2 Patched App + xDrip + Follower - calibrations
symptom: When entering a calibration on the primary phone, the follower phone shows a different BG value because it does not use the calibration but instead shows values from the LibreLink patched app.
evidence_quote: When I enter calibration, it works in my phone, but follower phone shows different BG. (it does not use calibration, but instead shows values from LibreLink patch app)
